part.text:
Fixed cookie filtering for array-valued log fields.

`modules/logging/filterencoder.go` now reads cookie values from `zapcore.Field.Interface` (used for HTTP header arrays) and writes filtered values back there, while preserving string-field support. This makes `request>headers>Cookie` filters actually redact cookies.

Validated with `go test ./modules/logging/...` — all tests pass.
